people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
translations.bsb: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
translations.kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him ➔ not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
translations.asv: but if a man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.
